name: summer-blonde-babe-confident-back
image_purpose: Summer social post and sporty lifestyle visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic low-angle outdoor summer portrait of an approved adult blonde woman beneath a vivid blue sky.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with long loose hair, wearing the reference's yellow crop top, black athletic shorts with white trim, patterned black-and-white bandana, silver bangle, and holding the reference beverage can. Preserve natural proportions and relaxed confidence.
prompt.composition_elements: Low-angle view from behind and slightly upward, subject turned partly over her shoulder with the beverage can in one hand. Use bright blue sky and light clouds as the dominant background, with a simple outdoor deck edge at the bottom.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural sunlight, clear crisp daylight, gentle highlights on hair and shoulders, realistic shadows, fresh confident summer mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens look, 4:5 vertical composition, sharp realistic skin and fabric texture, natural color, subtle film grain, believable smartphone lifestyle photography.

She wears the reference's yellow crop top, black athletic shorts with white trim, patterned black-and-white bandana, and silver bangle, holding the reference beverage can in one hand. Bright natural sunlight, crisp daylight, gentle highlights on hair and shoulders, realistic shadows, simple outdoor deck edge, confident fresh sporty lifestyle mood, 35mm lens look, natural skin and fabric texture, subtle film grain.
